dfm_alerts.description: The part tolerance conflicts with the tighter CNC-panel tolerance, leaving the factory without a clear acceptance limit.
dfm_alerts.fix: Issue dimensioned drawings that identify which features use the CNC tolerance and which use the general tolerance; define inspection datums.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Specify feature-specific tolerances and datums on production drawings — ISO 1101.

dfm_alerts.description: The fastener set lacks hole sizes, edge distances, insertion depths and an assembly sequence. Plywood joints may split or loosen if these are selected on the line.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify the hardware and pilot-hole pattern, verify edge distances and pull-out strength, and provide an assembly drawing.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Verify structural strength and stability of changing units — EN 12221-1.

dfm_alerts.description: The guard specification does not define installed height, continuity, attachment or gaps at joints, so the assembled unit cannot be checked for containment and entrapment.
dfm_alerts.fix: Dimension the assembled guards and joint gaps; test the production assembly against the target-market changing-unit requirements.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Changing-unit safety requirements and test methods — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

dfm_alerts.description: The changing pad has no specified retention method and may shift during use.
dfm_alerts.fix: Define a positive pad-retention method and verify it with the intended pad and finished deck.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Changing-unit safety requirements and test methods — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

dfm_alerts.description: Satin lacquer is listed as the foam pad's finish, but the wipe-clean cover material, seam construction and cleaning-chemical resistance are undefined.
dfm_alerts.fix: Remove the lacquer callout from the pad; specify cover material, sealed-seam construction and a cleaning-resistance test.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Define materials and finishes appropriate to foreseeable use and cleaning — ISO 12100 risk assessment principles.

dfm_alerts.description: The anti-tip kit does not specify compatible wall types, fixing selection or installation instructions; supplying anchors alone does not ensure a secure installation.
dfm_alerts.fix: Specify approved wall substrates and fixings, installation instructions and an assembled stability verification.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Changing-unit stability and instructions — EN 12221-1 and EN 12221-2.

dfm_alerts.description: Solid product (51.8 L of material): not an injection-moulded shell, so draft, undercut, wall thickness and clamp tonnage do not apply. Process: CNC routing of plywood sheet + edge finishing + flat-pack assembly.
dfm_alerts.fix: Quote the listed process; send the STEP as the shaping / routing / layout file.
dfm_alerts.rule_citation: Moulded-shell DFM rules apply to injection moulding only (Protolabs design guide)
